name: RC-B10-0195/2026 – § 14/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on supporting democratic resilience in Armenia
part_text: Text as a whole without the words: ‘financial and’
part_context: Calls for the EU to step up <del>financial and</del> technical assistance to Armenia, including through the resilience and growth plan, with a focus on strengthening institutional resilience, energy security, digital governance and economic diversification, and reducing structural dependencies in critical sectors such as energy, transport and infrastructure; encourages the Armenian Government to follow up on the reforms;
